title: Tech Saturn Tsuushin Vol. 4: Spring 1996: Youriyou Meippai Kikaku Tenkomori
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ サターン通信 Ｖｏｌ．４ 容量メいっぱい 企画てんこもり
overview: The CD-ROM packaged with the Spring 1996 issue (Vol. 4) of ASCII's TECH Saturn Tsuushin magazine. As its subtitle promises, the disc is filled to capacity with features, carrying demo versions of Saturn games alongside the magazine's own content.
